worst_for_postgres.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id JOIN locations l ON e.city = l.city JOIN assignments a ON e.emp_id = a.emp_id JOIN projects p ON d.dept_id = p.dept_id WHERE d.dept_name <> 'HR' AND e.age < 50 AND e.experience_years BETWEEN 0 AND 4 AND l.office_tier < 1 AND a.hours_per_week <= 26

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM departments d JOIN projects p ON d.dept_id = p.dept_id JOIN employees e ON e.dept_id = p.dept_id JOIN assignments a ON e.emp_id = a.emp_id WHERE d.dept_name = 'Operations' AND e.dept_id = 2 AND e.city = 'Hyderabad'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id JOIN locations l ON e.city = l.city WHERE e.experience_years BETWEEN 8 AND 18 AND e.salary BETWEEN 158520 AND 187319
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM locations l JOIN employees e ON e.city = l.city WHERE l.city <> 'Pune' AND e.age BETWEEN 25 AND 27 AND e.salary BETWEEN 82527 AND 193652
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM locations l JOIN employees e ON e.city = l.city JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE l.city = 'Mumbai' AND d.dept_name = 'Operations'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM departments d JOIN projects p ON d.dept_id = p.dept_id JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id JOIN assignments a ON p.proj_id = a.proj_id WHERE d.dept_name <> 'HR' AND p.priority IN ('Low', 'Medium') AND p.budget_tier < 1 AND a.hours_per_week > 10

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id JOIN assignments a ON e.emp_id = a.emp_id JOIN projects p ON p.proj_id = a.proj_id WHERE d.dept_name IN ('HR', 'Marketing', 'Sales') AND d.region <> 'North' AND e.dept_id = 1 AND a.hours_per_week >= 7
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects p JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = p.dept_id JOIN budgets b ON p.proj_id = b.proj_id WHERE p.dept_id IN (2, 3, 4) AND d.dept_name = 'Engineering'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM locations l JOIN employees e ON e.city = l.city JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id JOIN assignments a ON e.emp_id = a.emp_id WHERE l.city = 'Chennai' AND e.salary BETWEEN 175696 AND 211236 AND d.dept_name = 'Engineering' AND d.region = 'East' AND a.hours_per_week < 10

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects p JOIN budgets b ON p.proj_id = b.proj_id JOIN employees e ON e.dept_id = p.dept_id JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE b.approved_amount < 90093 AND e.age <= 24 AND e.dept_id = 1 AND d.dept_name <> 'Engineering'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM budgets b JOIN projects p ON p.proj_id = b.proj_id JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = p.dept_id WHERE b.approved_amount BETWEEN 157043 AND 304335 AND p.dept_id IN (4, 6) AND d.region = 'West' AND d.dept_name = 'Operations'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM locations l JOIN employees e ON e.city = l.city JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE l.city = 'Pune' AND l.office_tier >= 2 AND e.city = 'Chennai' AND e.age < 31 AND d.dept_name = 'Operations'
